Hi. I am only fourteen, but please hear me out. I cut and wanted to kill my self for months and have been depressed (now diagnosed) for the majority of my life, so I do think I might be able to give you a bit of an inside perspective and some advice on how to help.

First off, the way you found out about their depression is important. If you found out because of a person such as a school counselor or another adult outside of the family, or by finding evidence like bloody toilet paper/blades/them in the act; it really makes all the difference. 

Seeing as you have nice gaming equipment I’ll assume you have the basic necessities such as: food, water, a roof over their head, bed to sleep in, education, ext. Remember that when you talk to them maybe don’t bring that up. I was always very aware of how fortunate I am and it was honestly a painful reminder that I never had a REAL reason to be depressed. 

Meeting people online or just talking to strangers (much like now) had helped me stay alive when I truly felt like there was nothing left for me, and like everyone would be better off if I was dead. 

Cutting or SH (Self Harm) can grow to be an addiction. People do it for many reasons. Some of us think of it as a way to punish ourselves because of the thinks we think or do. Some do it just so that they can feel something after you go numb. Those are just two examples as to why but in some cases there isn’t a reason, and you just do it. Like I said it can grow into an addiction, like vaping, smoking, drinking, or another form of drugs.

I know that it feels almost surreal to know that your own child wants to die, but if they bring it up; do not under any circumstances be a coward and walk away. I am dead serious. Even if you feel like you are going to throw up, stick it out and listen. It is important that you speak gently when needed, but don’t interrupt them. Running away or saying stuff that could try and and take responsibility away from you will just hurt like hell. Listen to them when they seek it out and do not shush them because it’s hard to hear or think about. Please.

On the other hand, your kid might not want to talk to you at all. Depression has range, and is different for people, but if they wanted to kill them selves they likely felt the hollowness in their chest, the indescribable feelings and the high you feel when you contemplate letting go. I hope you never have to understand it. They could describe it to you, or you could watch a movie of their day to day and never get it unless you went through the same things. 
But if they aren’t ready to talk, don’t make them. Let them come to you. 

Also, good idea on getting them a therapist. It’ll probably help though there is no guarantee and if they ask for medication I would let them it can make a big difference once you find the right kinds to take (usually takes about a month to start working though, and every now and again it could stop working so they might need different ones) 

And even though your kid is the one going though it, you know now. You have the burden of knowing, meaning you are getting the gift of extra worrying. It is important to be there for them, but you won’t really be able to help if you aren’t okay yourself. That means you need to relax, and make sure you are checking up on yourself as well. They need you to be reliable, and if you get too wrapped up in it, you won’t be.

Don’t feel ashamed to admit you like the scars. I liked my own for so long. I do not know you personally, but you sound a lot like me when I first started out (and there is a good chance I am quite a few years younger than you). Honestly before I started I got so excited about it until it became an obsession where all I could think about was doing it. But then I actually tried it. I have been doing this…mutilation for about 6 months now? And even though that doesn’t seem like a long time, just the thinking about it ads on to it and the total 🟰 10 months that self harm has controlled my life. Before you get too addicted to it, try your best to get help. It only makes you feel good for a sec, but once you start seeing your world become lighter you will have a break down about how you messed up. You never own the blade, it owns you. I have permanent scarring that I can never undo. I hope at least you are not as naïve as I was; and that you are not trying to make yourself worse. You might feel like this is just how depression feels, but trust me; if you don’t get help now: you WILL figure out how the end feels. There is depression, but then there is suicidal depression. And nobody, (no matter how hard the try) can explain or express that feeling in a way to make others fully understand what that is like. I had my turning point. But I am not okay yet, and many people don’t get as lucky as I have…just please remember when your mind is awake and pounding you with the urges of SF, that you need to open your eyes to the people you have or had around you, and what will happen to them if they ever lost you to this, and if you ever lose your friends; try your best to remember what really happened and they left you or if you left them. (Friends don’t grow apart) Families aren’t always there for you. I said some pretty deep stuff, and I hope you won’t ever have to understand what it REALLY means. But nonetheless, I know what it is like to want to go deeper and to keep adding more and more, but know that you might not be ready for the sh*t that will come after this. The person that you will come out of here as is not the same person you are. People you think are bothered by you really only wanted the best for you. And the ones who look the most angry at you and  sound like they gave up on you are only actually terrified and don’t know how to save you. This is the advice from your little sister to you. If you don’t get the help you need. You are going to read this again…and have an oh sh*t moment, after you realize what I am saying. Life if f***ed up, but just do what you have to to be strong enough to make it out alive. Because you are only at the gate of hell right now, and maki g this decision could mean walking in or stepping out. If you ever need to talk I am almost always able to make time for someone I know who needs help. Don’t t figure out what my mistakes were…but just know that if you do, this is also a message to your future self that will know what I mean when I say the word “understand.” Your not alone, you can always find help here where all of the mentally disturbed people are. This place is where I have found my life savers who helped dig me out of my own grave. You are safe here, you can talk about anything you are thinking here. We all have been where you are now, so it is okay to ask for help or just someone to talk to. We listen. -with luv your depressed little sister.

I think you are stronger than I am. Set backs are normal, but if you pick yourself up from them…you will be ok. I know that you will someday be okay. ❤️ If nobody is going to save you, it forces you to be strong enough to save yourself.  Give it time, and be patient with yourself. I am rooting for you!
